words.ex_cn: 我将来会去上大学。
words.en: at a time after the present

words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.tr: phrase. 洗车服务；洗车场所
words.ex: He goes to the car wash every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都去洗车。
words.en: A car wash is a facility used to clean the exterior and, in some cases, the interior of motor vehicles.

words.tr: phrase. 卖饼干；饼干义卖活动
words.ex: The school organized a cookie sale to raise funds for new playground equipment.
words.ex_cn: 学校组织了一次饼干销售，为新游乐场设备筹集资金。
words.en: A cookie sale is an event where cookies are sold, often as a fundraiser.

words.tr: phrase. 赢得头奖；获得一等奖
words.ex: He win first prize in the small competition.
words.ex_cn: 他在小比赛中赢得了一等奖。
words.en: To be the winner of the top award in a competition.

words.ex: He is interested in math.
words.ex_cn: 他对数学感兴趣。
words.en: To have a feeling of curiosity or concern about something, wanting to learn or know more about it.

words.tr: phrase. 一块；一张；一片；一件
words.ex: He ate a piece of bread.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一片面包。
words.en: A portion or part of something.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 不同种类的；各种各样的
words.ex: There are different kinds of fruits in the market.
words.ex_cn: 市场上有不同种类的水果。
words.en: phrase. various types or categories of something

words.tr: phrase. 从……转移到……；从……搬到……；从……变动到……
words.ex: They move from house to apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他们从房子搬到了公寓。
words.en: To change one's location or position from one place to another.

words.tr: phrase. 过来；顺便来访；改变立场；突然感觉；显得
words.ex: Come over to my house after school.
words.ex_cn: 放学后到我家来。
words.en: To move or travel towards someone or something, especially in order to visit them.

words.tr: 短语动词，在……方面表现良好；在……中取得成功
words.ex: He does well in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上表现很好。
words.en: To perform successfully in a particular activity or subject.

words.tr: phrase. 交朋友；建立友谊；与人结交
words.ex: He wants to make friends at school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在学校交朋友。
words.en: To establish a relationship of mutual affection with someone, typically one that is not a romantic or family relationship.

words.tr: phrase. 同时；但是；在相同的时间
words.ex: He sings and dances at the same time.
words.ex_cn: 他一边唱歌一边跳舞。
words.en: If two or more things exist, happen, or are true at the same time, they exist, happen, or are true together although they seem to contradict each other.

words.tr: phrase. 喜欢做某事；享受做某事的过程
words.ex: I enjoy doing my homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上都喜欢做作业。
words.en: To take pleasure in performing a particular activity.

words.tr: phrase. 保持体形；维持良好的身体状态
words.ex: She exercises regularly to stay in shape.
words.ex_cn: 她定期锻炼以保持体型。
words.en: To maintain a good physical condition or fitness level.

words.ex: The numbers don't add up.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字对不上。
words.en: If facts or events do not add up, they make you confused about a situation because they do not seem to be consistent. If small amounts of something add up, they gradually increase.

words.tr: phrase. 在某人的空闲时间；闲暇时
words.ex: He likes to read books in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间喜欢读书。
words.en: During the time when one is not working or occupied; leisure time.

words.ex: She loves to play an instrument in her free time.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢在空闲时间演奏乐器。
words.en: To perform music on a musical instrument.

words.ex: They go on a trip every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们每年夏天去旅行。
words.en: To go on a trip means to travel somewhere, especially for pleasure or a holiday.

words.ex: He likes apples, for example.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果，例如。
words.en: Used when you want to give a specific instance or illustration of what you are talking about.

words.ex: I have lunch at noon every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天中午吃午饭。
words.en: To eat the midday meal.

words.w: in a hurry to do something
words.tr: phrase. 匆忙地做某事；急于做某事
words.uk: ɪn ə ˈhʌri tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: ɪn ə ˈhɜːri tə duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: He is in a hurry to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他急着去赶公交车。
words.en: If you are in a hurry to do something, you need or want to do something quickly.

words.ex: He likes to surf the internet after school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢放学后上网。
words.en: To browse the World Wide Web.

words.tr: 短语动词：帮助某人做某事，协助某人处理某事
words.ex: He helps me with my homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天帮我做作业。
words.en: If you help someone with something, you assist them in doing it.

words.tr:
v. 热爱；爱；
n. 爱；爱情；爱好的事物；
words.ex: I love playing football with my friends.
words.ex_cn: 我热爱和朋友们一起踢足球。
words.en: Love is a very strong feeling of affection towards someone that you are romantically or sexually attracted to.

words.tr: phrase. 用电话交谈；在通话
words.ex: He is talking on the phone with his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他正在和妈妈打电话。
words.en: Using the telephone to communicate with someone.

words.tr: 短语. 祝你周末愉快
words.ex: I just wanted to say have a great weekend!
words.ex_cn: v. 我只是想说祝你周末愉快！
words.en: To wish someone a pleasant and enjoyable weekend.

words.ex: I hope you have a good weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我希望你有一个愉快的周末。
words.en: To wish someone a pleasant weekend.

words.ex: He takes a bus to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天乘公交车去学校。
words.en: To travel by bus; to use bus transportation.

words.ex: He walked away from the house.
words.ex_cn: 他远离了房子。
words.en: If someone or something moves or is moved away from a place, they move or are moved so that they are no longer there.

words.tr: 短语动词. 进行一次愉快的交谈；谈得愉快
words.ex: We have a good talk every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天晚上都聊得很愉快。
words.en: To engage in a pleasant conversation or discussion.

words.tr: phrase. 祝贺你！干得好！（用于表达对他人好事的赞赏或祝贺）
words.ex: You passed the test? Good for you!
words.ex_cn: 你通过考试了？太好了！
words.en: An expression of approval or congratulations for someone's achievement.

words.ex: My mom is proud of me because I passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈为我通过考试而感到骄傲。
words.en: To feel a sense of pride or satisfaction in something or someone.

words.ex: He says he likes sports, but in fact, he hates them.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢运动，但事实上，他讨厌它们。
words.en: You use in fact to emphasize that something is true, especially when it contradicts what has just been said or might be expected.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 开始用力吃；深入研究；扎根；开始认真工作
words.ex: The soldiers had to dig in quickly to protect themselves from enemy fire.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们不得不迅速挖战壕以保护自己免受敌人的火力攻击。
words.en: To start doing something with a lot of effort or enthusiasm, especially eating or working.

words.ex: I look up the word in the dictionary.
words.ex_cn: 我在字典里查这个词。
words.en: If you look up a fact or a piece of information, you find it by looking in something such as a reference book or a list.

words.ex: They enjoy themselves at the park every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每个星期天在公园里玩得很开心。
words.en: To have a good time; to experience pleasure or satisfaction in what one is doing.

words.ex: He is listening to the teacher in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时听老师讲课。
words.en: During a lesson or lecture in a classroom setting.

words.ex: We play soccer after class.
words.ex_cn: 我们课后踢足球。
words.en: After class refers to the time following a class or lesson when students are free to engage in other activities.

words.tr: phrase. 害怕做某事；不敢做某事
words.ex_cn: 他不敢在课堂上发言。
words.en: If you are afraid to do something, you are frightened to do it or unwilling to do it because you think it might be dangerous or harmful.

words.ex: He made a mistake in his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他在作业中犯了一个错误。
words.en: If you make a mistake, you do something which you did not intend to do, or which produces a result that you do not want.

words.ex: He makes mistakes when he solves math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解数学题时会犯错。
words.en: To make a mistake means to do something incorrectly or to have an incorrect understanding of something.

words.ex: They laugh at his funny hat.
words.ex_cn: 他们因他的滑稽帽子而发笑。
words.en: To laugh at someone or something means to mock or ridicule them, often in a way that is not kind.

words.ex: He is eating lunch right now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在正在吃午饭。
words.en: At this very moment; immediately.

words.tr: 短语. 对……有深入了解；精通……
words.ex: She has a good knowledge of ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 她对古代历史有很好的了解。
words.en: A phrase used to indicate that someone has a thorough understanding or familiarity with a particular subject or field.

words.ex: He communicates with his friend every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天和朋友交流。
words.en: To exchange information or ideas with someone or something.

words.ex: He asks for help when he is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当他遇到困难时，他会寻求帮助。
words.en: To request something; to express a desire for something.

words.ex: The bridge connects the two cities.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥连接了两座城市。
words.en: If something or someone connects one thing to another, or if one thing connects to another, the two things are joined together.

words.tr:
v. 帮助；
n. 帮助；
words.ex: He helps his sister with her homework.
words.ex_cn: 他帮助妹妹做作业。
words.en: If you help someone, you make it easier for them to do something, for example by doing part of the work for them or by giving them advice or information.

words.ex: He plays chess every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上下棋。
words.en: To engage in the game of chess, a strategic board game between two players.

words.ex: I try to do my homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上都努力做作业。
words.en: To make an attempt or effort to accomplish something.

words.ex: I look forward to the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我期待着周末。
words.en: If you look forward to something that is going to happen, you want it to happen because you think you will enjoy it.

words.ex: I wake up at seven every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上七点醒来。
words.en: To stop sleeping and become conscious, or to make someone stop sleeping.

words.tr: phrase. 离开；外出；（症状）消失
words.ex: Go away, I need to rest.
words.ex_cn: 走开，我需要休息。
words.en: To leave a place or to stop being present in a situation.

words.ex: He goes swimming every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末去游泳。
words.en: To engage in the activity of swimming, typically in a body of water such as a pool, lake, or ocean.

words.ex: We plan to go skiing in the Alps next winter.
words.ex_cn: 我们计划明年冬天去阿尔卑斯山滑雪。
words.en: To engage in the activity of skiing, typically as a form of recreation or sport.

words.ex: They go skating every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周末去滑冰。
words.en: To engage in the activity of skating, typically on ice.

words.tr: phrase. 打雪仗；互相投掷雪球玩耍
words.ex: The children love to have snowball fights in the winter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在冬天打雪仗。
words.en: To engage in a recreational activity where snowballs are thrown at each other.

words.tr: phrase. 好的工作；出色的表现
words.ex: He did good work on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中表现得很好。
words.en: A phrase used to express approval or satisfaction with someone's effort or achievement.

words.tr: phrase. 卓越的工作；出色的成果
words.ex: He solved the algebra problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解出了这道代数题。
words.en: An exclamation of strong approval or admiration for an achievement or action.

words.ex: I wait for the bus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上等公交车。
words.en: To remain in a place until a particular time or until something else happens.

words.tr:
n. 研究；探索；调查；
v. 研究；调查；探讨；
words.ex: He did research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了关于气候变化的研究。
words.en: Research is work that involves studying something and trying to discover facts about it.

words.ex: We get together every weekend to play basketball.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周末聚在一起打篮球。
words.en: If people get together, they meet in order to spend time with each other.

words.tr: adj. 角的；有角的；尖角的；
words.ex: The angular shape of the triangle is clear.
words.ex_cn: 三角形的角形很清晰。
words.en: having angles or sharp corners; lean and bony

words.tr: phrase. 轮到某人做……；该某人做……了
words.ex: It's your turn to clean the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 轮到你打扫教室了。
words.en: When it's one's turn to do something, it is their opportunity or responsibility to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 玩接球游戏；互相投接球
words.ex: The boy plays catch with his dad in the park.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在公园里和他爸爸玩接球游戏。
words.en: To engage in a game where players throw a ball to each other and try to catch it.

words.ex: He poured maple syrup on his pancakes.
words.ex_cn: 他把枫糖浆倒在煎饼上。
words.en: Maple syrup is a sweet syrup made from the sap of maple trees, primarily the sugar maple, red maple, or black maple, although it can be made from other maple species as well.

words.ex: We have a picnic in the park on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日去公园野餐。
words.en: To eat a meal outdoors, especially in the countryside or a park, as part of an excursion or outing.

words.tr: phrase. 嗨，伙计们！（澳大利亚口语，用于打招呼，相当于 Hello, everyone!）
words.ex: G'day mates! Let's go fishing this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 你好，伙计们！这个周末去钓鱼吧。
words.en: An informal Australian greeting meaning 'Hello, friends!

words.ex: This book is different from that one.
words.ex_cn: 这本书和那本书不一样。
words.en: To not be the same as something or someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 乘风破浪；冲浪；顺应潮流；在波涛中航行
words.ex: He loves to ride the waves at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在海滩上冲浪。
words.en: To successfully deal with or manage the changes or challenges that one encounters.

words.tr: 短语. 说实话；老实说
words.ex: To tell you the truth, I was a bit nervous about the presentation.
words.ex_cn: 说实话，我对这次演讲有点紧张。
words.en: used when admitting something

words.ex: He arrived late, as usual.
words.ex_cn: 他像往常一样迟到了。
words.en: As usual means in the same way as what happens most of the time or in most cases.

words.tr: 短语动词. 做一个梦；拥有一个梦想
words.ex: He has a dream to be a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个成为老师的梦想。
words.en: To possess a vision or aspiration for the future.

words.ex: You should eat vegetables and exercise to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 你应该吃蔬菜并锻炼以保持健康。
words.en: To remain in good physical and mental condition.

words.tr: 短语动词. 进行一些锻炼；做些运动
words.ex: He gets some exercise every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上进行一些锻炼。
words.en: To engage in physical activity to maintain or improve health and fitness.

words.ex: Don't get in the way when others are working.
words.ex_cn: 当别人工作时，不要挡道。
words.en: If something or someone gets in the way, they prevent you from doing something or make it more difficult for you to do it.

words.ex: He used to play soccer every day.
words.ex_cn: 他过去每天踢足球。
words.en: If something used to be done or used to be the case, it was done regularly in the past or was the case in the past.

words.ex: Don't worry about the test. You will do well.
words.ex_cn: 别担心考试，你会考好的。
words.en: To feel anxious or concerned about something or someone.

words.ex: He does not play soccer any more.
words.ex_cn: 他不再踢足球了。
words.en: Used to indicate that a situation or action has changed and no longer exists or happens.

words.tr: phrase. 体重增加；发胖；增重
words.ex: He put on weight after he stopped running.
words.ex_cn: 他停止跑步后长胖了。
words.en: To become heavier or fatter.

words.tr: phrase. 成天懒散在家、久坐不动看电视的人；电视迷
words.ex: He is a couch potato who watches TV all day.
words.ex_cn: 他是个整天看电视的沙发土豆。
words.en: A couch potato is a person who spends a lot of time sitting or lying down, usually watching television.

words.ex: He told the dog to get out.
words.ex_cn: 他让狗出去。
words.en: To leave or escape from a place or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 在阳光下；处于阳光之中
words.ex: The cat sleeps in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 猫在阳光下睡觉。
words.en: Exposed to or illuminated by the sun's rays.

words.tr: phrase. 在某人的一边；支持某人
words.ex: Don't worry, I am on your side.
words.ex_cn: 别担心，我站在你这边。
words.en: Supporting or agreeing with someone in a dispute or argument.

words.ex: He goes fishing on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末去钓鱼。
words.en: To go fishing means to spend time trying to catch fish, typically as a hobby or for relaxation.

words.tr: 短语动词. 去打猎；去搜寻
words.ex: He goes hunting every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末去打猎。
words.en: To engage in the activity of hunting animals for sport or food.

words.tr: phrase. 第一民族（加拿大原住民中除因纽特人外的各部落的统称）
words.ex: The first nations live on land that was here long ago.
words.ex_cn: 原住民生活在很久以前就存在的土地上。
words.en: First Nations refers to the indigenous peoples of Canada, specifically those who are not Inuit or Métis. It is a term used to collectively describe the various Indigenous peoples in Canada who are recognized as original inhabitants of the land.

words.ex: I was happy at that time.
words.ex_cn: 在那时，我很快乐。
words.en: At a particular time in the past.

words.ex: He made a fire to keep warm.
words.ex_cn: 他生了一堆火来取暖。
words.en: To start a fire, especially for heating or cooking.

words.ex: I get up at seven o'clock every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上七点起床。
words.en: To rise from bed after sleeping; to stand up; to increase in amount or level.

words.ex: He spends money on books.
words.ex_cn: 他花钱买书。
words.en: To spend means to use money to buy or pay for something, or to use time or energy in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 铺床；整理床铺；自作自受（比喻意义）
words.ex: Every morning, he makes his bed before breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 每天早上，他在吃早餐前都会整理床铺。
words.en: To arrange the sheets, blankets, and pillows on a bed so that it is neat and ready for someone to sleep in. It can also mean to accept the consequences of one's actions.

words.ex: He will lead the way to the park.
words.ex_cn: 他将带路去公园。
words.en: To go first in order to show others how to follow; to be a pioneer or innovator in a particular field.

words.ex: I have visited that park a few times.
words.ex_cn: 我去过那个公园几次。
words.en: On several occasions; not many times.

words.ex: He will take an exam tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要参加考试。
words.en: To participate in a test or examination to assess one's knowledge or proficiency in a particular subject.

words.ex: He plays basketball every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末打篮球。
words.en: To engage in the sport of basketball, which involves two teams of five players each trying to score points by throwing a ball through a hoop.

words.tr: phrase. 打网球：进行一项运动，使用网球拍和网球在网球场上进行比赛或练习。
words.ex: He plays tennis every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打网球。
words.en: To engage in the sport of tennis, which involves hitting a ball over a net using rackets.

words.ex: We play volleyball every weekend at the beach.
words.ex_cn: v. 我们每个周末都在海滩打排球。
words.en: To engage in the sport of volleyball, which involves hitting a ball over a net without letting it touch the ground on your side.

words.tr: phrase. 照顾；照料；处理；应付
words.ex: She takes care of her little brother after school.
words.ex_cn: 她放学后照顾她的弟弟。
words.en: To look after someone or something; to deal with something.

words.tr: phrase. 搬走；离开；远离；移开
words.ex: She decided to move away from the city to a quieter place.
words.ex_cn: 她决定离开城市，搬到一个更安静的地方。
words.en: To leave the place where you have been living or working, and go to live or work somewhere else.

words.tr: phrase. 不打扰；不干涉；让…独自待着
words.ex: Please leave me alone when I am studying.
words.ex_cn: 当我学习时，请不要打扰我。
words.en: To allow someone or something to remain undisturbed or not to interfere with them.

words.tr: phrase. 遛狗；带狗出去散步
words.ex: He walks the dog every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上遛狗。
words.en: To take a dog for a walk, typically on a leash, to allow it to exercise and relieve itself.

words.ex: He will play against his friend tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天将和朋友比赛。
words.en: To compete in a game or sport against someone or a team.

words.tr: phrase. 拿出；取出；去掉；取得；领到
words.ex: He took out his keys to open the door.
words.ex_cn: 他拿出钥匙开门。
words.en: To remove something from a place or to take something with you when you go somewhere.

words.ex: We root for our team in every game.
words.ex_cn: 我们在每场比赛中都为我们的队伍加油。
words.en: To support or cheer for someone or something, especially in a competition.

words.ex: We eat lunch at noon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃午饭。
words.en: At noon means at 12 o'clock in the middle of the day.

words.tr: 短语动词. 举行聚会；参加派对
words.ex: They have a party on Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他们在周六举办派对。
words.en: To organize and hold a social gathering with guests, typically involving food, drink, and entertainment.

words.tr: phrase. 上课；接受教学（通常指学习某项技能或知识）
words.ex: He takes lessons every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六上课。
words.en: To attend classes or sessions for the purpose of learning or improving skills in a particular subject or activity.

words.ex: He takes classes at the local community center.
words.ex_cn: 他在当地的社区中心上课。
words.en: To attend educational sessions or courses.

words.tr: phrase. 继续做；持续做；不断做
words.ex: He keeps doing his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都坚持做作业。
words.en: To continue doing something without stopping.

words.tr: phrase. 夏令营；暑期营地活动
words.ex: The children went to summer camp last July.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们去年七月去了夏令营。
words.en: A summer camp is a supervised program for children or teenagers conducted during the summer months in some countries.

words.tr:
v. 共享；分享；
n. 分享；股份；
words.ex: They share their food with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们与朋友分享食物。
words.en: If you share something with another person, you both have it, use it, or are involved in it. You can also say that two people share something.
